prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble, in real places. Underneath, a realistic close-up: an old woman in a frozen attic, frost on her eyelashes and on the wool shawl over her head, breath steaming, a deeply lined face with a mole on her cheek, her hands cupped round one candle flame. Camera close, at the height of the candle. Light: the candle only. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
